hero.title: Capture leads while they are still talking to you.
hero.body: Visitors ask a few questions and leave before filling in a form. Your agent answers them and collects the details your team needs during the conversation.
hero.reassurance: Details collected in the chat. Saved to your CRM or HubSpot. Your team follows up with context.

seo.title: AI lead capture agent for your website and WhatsApp | Steps AI
seo.description: Answer visitor questions and collect lead details during the conversation. Save leads to the Steps AI CRM or HubSpot.

walkthrough.title: From a question to a qualified lead.
walkthrough.intro: A visitor on your pricing page.

steps.label: Answer the first question
steps.agent: Yes, WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger connect through one Meta connection on paid plans.
steps.note: The agent answers before it asks for anything.

steps.label: Ask for details
steps.customer: We have three stores. Could you send a quote?
steps.agent: Happy to. May I have your name, work email and company?
steps.note: Only the fields you switched on are asked for.

steps.label: Save the lead
steps.agent: Thank you Meera. Our team will send your quote today.
steps.note: The lead is saved with where it came from and which agent it spoke to.

capabilities.title: What your lead capture agent can do.
capabilities.intro: Better leads, with the conversation that came before.

items.title: Collect the fields you need
items.body: Name, email, company, job title and custom fields, with required settings.

items.title: Verify leads
items.body: Show a lead popup that verifies visitors by email or phone code.

items.title: Save to your CRM or HubSpot
items.body: Leads go to the built-in CRM or to HubSpot.

items.title: Tag the conversation
items.body: Conversations are tagged as lead, prospect or customer and by marketing source.

tools.title: Works with your sales tools.
tools.intro: Send leads where your team already works.

quote.excerpt: We were losing good inquiries because people would ask a few questions and leave without filling out the form. Now StepsAI gets the details while they’re already talking and passes the lead into our CRM with the conversation attached.
quote.attribution: Ryan Collins | Growth Lead | Northstar SaaS

goodToKnow.title: Good to know
items: The agent saves what visitors share. It does not identify anonymous visitors.
Lead limits depend on your plan.

faq.title: Questions about the AI lead capture agent.

items.q: Will it ask every visitor for their email?
items.a: No. You decide when the lead skill is used, in plain English, with examples of when it should not be.

items.q: Can it book a call too?
items.a: Yes. Add the booking skill and the agent can book a call after it captures the lead.

cta.title: See the AI lead capture agent with your own business in mind.
cta.body: Book a demo and we will walk through it using your own information and channels.
